title: TxGNN: repurposing existing drugs for rare diseases
summary: The model covers about 8,000 drugs across 17,080 diseases and is nearly 50% better than competitors at identifying candidates and 35% more accurate on contraindications. It was tested on 1.2 million medical records and on three rare diseases excluded from training. Computational predictions only, with no laboratory or clinical confirmation.

evidence.tested: The model was checked against about 8,000 drugs and 17,080 diseases, validated on 1.2 million medical records, and asked to find drugs for three rare diseases excluded from training; it was compared with leading drug-repurposing models.
evidence.unknown: Identified therapies would require further evaluation for dosing and delivery, and there is no laboratory or clinical confirmation.
evidence.ai_role: Proposed existing drugs for thousands of diseases, predicted contraindications and side effects, and gave a rationale for each prediction.
